title: [master]-Cannot delete Project Planning Line due to incorrect reservation entries
summary: Fixes a bug where a Project Planning Line could not be deleted because incorrect reservation entries existed. The fix is in the Inventory Profile Offsetting codeunit, which is used for planning, and a test was added for the scenario.
key_points: Changes reservation handling in codeunit Inventory Profile Offsetting
Addresses incorrect reservation entries that blocked deleting project planning lines
Adds a regression test to the SCM planning tests
quote: Cannot delete Project Planning Line due to incorrect reservation entries
